t: The Grundfos UPS4 GO 25-65 130 domestic heating circulator pump is built for reliable and efficient operation in heating and air conditioning systems. Offering a q max. flow volume of up to 3.9m³/hr, and features three control modes with adjustable speed settings to match system demand. The pump’s robust startup tackles harsh conditions, reducing the risk of blockages from magnetite, limescale and dirt. With dry-running protection and quiet operation at 32 dB(A), it ensures dependable performance and enhanced comfort in domestic installations.
